body.html:
Kanpur – A burqa-clad woman praying in a Shiva temple in the Mandhana area has gone viral, stirring debate across social media. According to reports, the Muslim woman had a close relative admitted in a nearby private hospital in critical condition.

In a moment of helplessness, she vowed to offer prayers at the temple if her relative recovered. After his condition improved, she returned and performed Puja with full rituals. The video, showing her worshipping Lord Shiva, was recorded by onlookers and widely shared online.

While the video’s authenticity remains unverified b, it has sparked discussion on religious harmony and the power of faith over boundaries.

articles.title: Ambedkar Statue Vandalised in Bareilly Village, Tension Erupts – CCTV Captures 3 Accused!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bareilly, UP – Tension flared in Gangapur village under Nawabganj police station after miscreants vandalised a newly installed statue of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar on Wednesday night. The act, caught on CCTV, has sparked outrage among Baba Saheb’s followers.

body.html:
Bareilly, UP – Tension flared in Gangapur village under Nawabganj police station after miscreants vandalised a newly installed statue of Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar on Wednesday night. The act, caught on CCTV, has sparked outrage among Baba Saheb’s followers.

As per police, three youths were seen damaging the statue, which was installed without official permission on village society land amidst ongoing local disputes. By Thursday morning, anger spread as villagers discovered the damaged statue.

SDM, Tehsildar, and Inspector Rahul Singh reached the spot and assured action. A complaint filed by local resident Tarachandra also accuses the miscreants of using casteist slurs and issuing threats. Police have detained three individuals; further action is underway.

articles.title: 16-Year-Old Hyderabad Girl Strangles Mother Over Instagram Love Affair
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad – In a shocking case from Lal Bahadur Nagar under Jeedimetla PS limits, a 16-year-old girl, Tejasree, allegedly murdered her mother Anjali (39) with the help of her boyfriend, Pagilla Shiva (19), and his brother Yashwanth (18).

body.html:
Hyderabad – In a shocking case from Lal Bahadur Nagar under Jeedimetla PS limits, a 16-year-old girl, Tejasree, allegedly murdered her mother Anjali (39) with the help of her boyfriend, Pagilla Shiva (19), and his brother Yashwanth (18). The motive: the mother’s objection to their relationship.

Police said Tejasree was in a relationship with Shiva for eight months after meeting on Instagram. A week ago, she had eloped with him but returned home after police counselling. Days later, she allegedly strangled her mother with a dupatta and hit her with a blunt object.

Jeedimetla police have registered a murder case and taken all three into custody. Investigation is ongoing.

articles.title: Udaipur Girl Murdered by Instagram Boyfriend in Hotel After Engagement News
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Udaipur, Rajasthan – A shocking murder took place in a hotel near Parshuram Chauraha, where 27-year-old Vijay Bhoi allegedly killed his girlfriend Nikita Trivedi by smashing her head against a wall. The incident occurred after the two argued over Nikita’s recent engagement.

body.html:
Udaipur, Rajasthan – A shocking murder took place in a hotel near Parshuram Chauraha, where 27-year-old Vijay Bhoi allegedly killed his girlfriend Nikita Trivedi by smashing her head against a wall. The incident occurred after the two argued over Nikita’s recent engagement.

The two had met through Instagram and were in a relationship for some time. When Nikita stopped speaking to Vijay after her engagement, he called her to meet one last time. During the heated argument in the hotel room, Vijay fatally assaulted her. He then tried to commit suicide by slitting his wrist but fled the scene in pain.

The hotel’s housekeeping staff discovered the body the next morning and informed police. CCTV and hotel ID helped trace Vijay, who was found admitted in a hospital and is now in police custody. Nikita was a nursing student and resident of Hiran Magri.
